AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: This app keeps a personal record of whether you've checked the front door. Operational Patterns: - Use 'isFrontDoorChecked' to see whether the front door has been marked as checked. - Use 'setFrontDoorChecked' to record that you checked the front door, or to reset that record. Constraints: - This is a personal reminder log only; it doesn't control, lock, unlock, or actuate any physical door hardware.
